description: This file contains the implementation of an in-memory queue cache for streaming data in Orleans, including classes for cache buckets, cache items, and the main cache class with methods for managing cache items, cursors, and backpressure detection.

classes.name: CacheBucket
classes.description: Represents a histogram bucket used for backpressure detection, tracking current items and cursors.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheItem
classes.description: Represents an individual cache item containing a batch, sequence token, and associated cache bucket.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCache
classes.description: Main in-memory queue cache class implementing IQueueCache, managing cache items, cursors, and backpressure detection.

methods.name: UpdateNumItems
methods.description: Updates the number of current items in the cache bucket.

methods.name: UpdateNumCursors
methods.description: Updates the number of cursors pointing to the cache bucket.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch containers to the cache.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cursor for iterating over cache items starting at a specific sequence token.

methods.name: InitializeCursor
methods.description: Initializes a cursor to a specific position based on a sequence token.

methods.name: RefreshCursor
methods.description: Refreshes or initializes a cursor's position based on a sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message at the cursor position.

methods.name: AdvanceCursor
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the next cache item.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor to a specific cache item.

methods.name: UnsetCursor
methods.description: Unsets the cursor, removing it from the current cache bucket.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new batch container to the cache, managing cache size and buckets.
